about: What the app's address tells the browser on every answer, the worker's (argon2id.js) as much as the page's: app.gogho.st's Caddy block (tool/deploy-site.mjs) and a relay's /app/ (relay/lib/web_app.dart), each held to this list by a test (test/web_build_test.dart, relay/test/web_app_test.dart). Content-Security-Policy is the page's own policy (web/index.html, its connect-src naming the hub the build is made for) followed by frame-ancestors 'none', which only a header can say. Strict-Transport-Security is app.gogho.st's alone: a relay's server in front of it says its own.
